videos.title: Mysteries of Praise
videos.description: Mysteries of Praise takes listeners on a deep, intimate journey into the hidden dimensions of worship. Blending haunting melodies with the spiritual depth of praying and singing in tongues, this solo performance explores the divine secrets unlocked when believers give thanks from the spirit. It’s a soundscape of reverence, surrender, and heavenly language — a reminder that praise is not just a song, but a spiritual key that opens the mysteries of God’s presence. #jesus #jesuschrist #elroi #jesusworldwide ##mysteriesofpraise

videos.title: How Great You Are
videos.description: How Great You Are is a vibrant Afrobeat-inspired praise anthem celebrating the unmatched attributes of God. From His boundless mercy to His infinite power, the song paints a colorful portrait of the Creator whose greatness no mind can fully comprehend. Rooted in African rhythm and soul, every beat, melody, and lyric invites listeners to dance, rejoice, and marvel at the wonders of the Almighty. It’s more than music — it’s a joyful reminder that God’s greatness transcends time, culture, and imagination. #afrogospel #elroi #nsppd #jesusworldwide #jesus #jesuschrist
